errors.stripeNotConfigured: Stripe keys are not set in the API, so the Stripe price cannot be checked. Create a manual-payment plan or set STRIPE_SECRET_KEY.
errors.stripeManaged: This club pays through Stripe — change the subscription in the Stripe dashboard.
errors.planExists: A plan with this code already exists.

plans.title: Plans
plans.description: Plans that clubs choose on the website and in the CRM. A plan cannot be deleted because subscriptions refer to it: take it off sale (archive) or hide it.
plans.hiddenHint: A hidden plan (trial, a 5 € test plan) is not shown on the website or in the CRM. A club can pick it only via the link:

form.createDescription: With a price id, amount, currency and interval come from Stripe. Without it, the plan is paid manually (bank transfer, cash).
form.editDescription: The plan code cannot be changed. Take it off sale — turn off On sale; remove it from the website — turn off Public.
form.codeHint: Lowercase latin letters, digits and dashes, e.g. club-month. Cannot be changed later.
form.name: Name
form.nameHint: Empty — the Stripe product name or the code is used.
form.stripePriceIdHint: Amount, currency and interval are taken from Stripe.
form.stripePriceIdEditHint: Empty — unlink the plan from Stripe. A new Stripe price does not change existing subscriptions: for a new price, better create a new plan and hide this one.
form.manualPriceHint: Amount, currency and interval can only be changed for a plan without Stripe.
form.isPublic: Public — shown on the website and in the CRM

clubs.title: Clubs
clubs.description: Club subscriptions. Record bank transfer or cash payments here — the subscription becomes active for the paid period.
clubs.noSubscriptionHint: The club has no subscription — actions are unavailable
clubs.cancelAtPeriodEnd: Canceled, ends at the end of the period

payment.title: Payment — {club}
payment.description: The subscription becomes active. The period is extended from the end of the paid period if it is still running, otherwise from today.

trial.title: Free period end — {club}
trial.description: The club uses the CRM for free until this date. You can extend or shorten it.
trial.activeWarning: The club is on a paid period now — after saving, the status changes to Free period.
